name: hilo3d
description: A TypeScript-first 3D engine with explicit WebGL 2 and WebGPU backends.

scripts.clean: rimraf .cache addon-particle/.cache addon-particle/dist addon-physics/.cache addon-physics/dist coverage dist dist-examples docs playwright-report reports site test-results
scripts.clean:build: rimraf .cache/types .cache/tsconfig.lib.tsbuildinfo addon-particle/.cache addon-particle/dist addon-physics/.cache addon-physics/dist dist
scripts.build: npm run clean:build && npm run build:js && npm run build:types && npm run addon:build
scripts.lint: npm run build:types && npm run addon:build && npm run lint:built
scripts.lint:fix: npm run build:types && npm run addon:build && npm run lint:built -- --fix
scripts.test:rhi: vitest run --config vitest.rhi.config.ts test/spec/rhi/portable && vitest run --config vitest.rhi-native.config.ts test/spec/rhi/portable/WebGPUBackend.native.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: npm run test:ui:contract && playwright test test/ui/examples.spec.ts test/ui/post-processing.spec.ts test/ui/runtime-parity.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:ui:webgl2: npm run test:ui:contract && playwright test test/ui/examples.spec.ts test/ui/post-processing.spec.ts test/ui/runtime-parity.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep @webgl2
scripts.test:ui:webgl2:ci: playwright test test/ui/examples.spec.ts test/ui/post-processing.spec.ts test/ui/runtime-parity.spec.ts test/ui/visual.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep "@webgl2|WebGL2"
scripts.test:ui:webgpu: npm run test:ui:contract && playwright test test/ui/examples.spec.ts test/ui/post-processing.spec.ts test/ui/runtime-parity.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep @webgpu
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:webgpu && npm run test:ui && npm run test:visual
scripts.test:browser:ci: npm run test:ui:webgl2 && npm run test:visual:webgl2
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package:built
scripts.test:addon-package: publint addon-physics && attw --pack addon-physics --profile esm-only && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts --workspace=@hilo3d/addon-physics
scripts.test:addon-particle-package: publint addon-particle && attw --pack addon-particle --profile esm-only && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts --workspace=@hilo3d/addon-particle
scripts.api:update: npm run build:types && npm run addon:build && npm run api:update:built
scripts.api:update:built: api-extractor run --local --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --local --config addon-particle/api-extractor.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --local --config addon-physics/api-extractor.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --local --config addon-physics/api-extractor.rapier2d.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --local --config addon-physics/api-extractor.rapier3d.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript
scripts.api:check: npm run build:types && npm run addon:build && npm run api:check:built
scripts.api:check:built: api-extractor run --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --config addon-particle/api-extractor.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --config addon-physics/api-extractor.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --config addon-physics/api-extractor.rapier2d.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript && api-extractor run --config addon-physics/api-extractor.rapier3d.json --typescript-compiler-folder node_modules/typescript
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:types && npm run docs:build:built
scripts.docs:check: npm run build:types && npm run docs:check:built
scripts.site:build: npm run api:check && npm run site:build:built
scripts.site:build:built: npm run docs:build:built && npm run examples:build && jiti scripts/build-site.ts && npm run site:check:links
scripts.validate: npm run clean && npm run check:modernity && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:skill && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:rhi && npm run test:rhi-benchmark-contract && npm run build && npm run test:types && npm run test:browser && npm run examples:build && npm run docs:check:built && npm run api:check:built && npm run test:package:built && npm run test:addon-package && npm run test:addon-particle-package && npm run pack:check
scripts.validate:ci: npm run clean && npm run check:modernity && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:ci && npm run test:skill && npm run test:rhi-benchmark-contract && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:rhi && npm run build && npm run test:types && npm run test:browser:ci && npm run examples:build && npm run docs:check:built && npm run api:check:built && npm run test:package:built && npm run test:addon-package && npm run test:addon-particle-package && npm run pack:check

author: 06wj
